question.text: The coefficient of $x^{10}$ in the expansion of $1+(1+x)+\dots+(1+x)^{20}$

solution.text:
The given series is in GP. Hence, its sum $S=\frac{1\left\{(1+x)^{20+1}-1\right\}}{(1+x)-1}=\frac{(1+x)^{21}-1}{x}$
Therefore, the required coefficient of $x^{10}$ in
the expansion of $(1+x)^{21}-1$
$=$ Coefficient of $x^{11}$ in the expansion of
$$
={ }^{21} C_{11}
$$
